title: Director of Engineering - Traffic & Networking
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a visionary Director of Traffic and Networking to lead the group responsible for the very circulatory system of our global cloud infrastructure.

THE MISSION

Every query, every login, every byte of data in Snowflake's Data Cloud travels through the systems this team builds. The Traffic & Networking group is responsible for the ingress, egress, domain management, and internal networking layers that connect thousands of customers to Snowflake across public and private connectivity paths. We build and deploy software to enable seamless service-to-service and user-to-service communication across all traffic types spanning every environment and cloud provider Snowflake touches. Your goal is to ensure robust domain management, efficient traffic flow, and reliable connectivity while relentlessly improving product velocity, and operational efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a senior engineering leader at Snowflake, you will be expected to:

- Set the Strategic Vision: Define the roadmap for Snowflake’s networking foundation and be accountable for the execution of complex plans and deliverables.

- Scale Infrastructure: Guide your team in building software solutions that automate and scale networking across multiple cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

- Drive Innovation: Lead projects from initial idea through design and implementation, collaborating with teams in the US, Ireland, Poland, and beyond.

- Technical Leadership: Provide deep technical expertise with a focus on high-performance, security, and the abstraction of complex cloud networking layers.

- Build the Team: Actively recruit, hire, and grow a diverse team of industry veterans and rising stars.

- Mentorship: Be responsible for the career development of your reports through continuous coaching and mentorship.

- Operational Excellence: Shift resources dynamically to respond to production issues and customer needs, ensuring high levels of reliability.

YOUR PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

- Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management leading leaders.

- Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

- Cloud Fluency: Strong hands-on experience with cloud service providers.

- SaaS Background: Deep experience working at scale within a multi-tenant or multi-single-tenant SaaS model, handling billions of complex queries and massive traffic ingress/egress.

- Communication: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between complex networking requirements and cross-functional business goals.

- Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

- Impact: You're actively evolving a network architecture, building new observability capabilities, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and designing the next-generation connectivity model across multiple clouds. Every Snowflake team depends on what this group ships. Infrastructure is our product.

title: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) - Caribbean
description:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)
Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide
Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Overview
The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.
Key Responsibilities:

• PCI DSS Compliance Management:
• Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

• Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.

• Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.

• Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:
Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or
equivalent work experience).

• Experience:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.

• Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.

• Certifications:
• Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

• Skills and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.

• Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.

• Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:
Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

• Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

• Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.

• Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.

• Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.

• Training and Awareness:

• Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.

• Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.

• Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.

• Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure our client from banking industry remains comp

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

- Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

title: Cardiac Device Specialist -Remote, All Shifts
description:
Position Title: Cardiac Device Specialist I
Location: 100% Remote (U.S. - candidates must reside in the contiguous United States)
About The Role
As a Cardiac Device Specialist at PaceMate®, you'll join a team of experienced professionals dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs). Working remotely, you'll use your expertise in cardiac electrophysiology and device management to analyze remote transmission data and diagnostics, interpret complex arrhythmias, and provide the accurate clinical documentation that providers rely on to guide patient care.
This role requires deep technical knowledge-you'll assess device function across multiple manufacturers, recognize abnormalities and arrhythmias, and recommend strategies to address issues. If you're passionate about applying your CIED expertise in a patient-centered environment that values compassion, integrity, and excellence, we'd like to hear from you.
What You’ll Do

• Remotely monitor patients with CIEDs using PaceMate's proprietary software

• Analyze and interpret ECG/EGM data and device diagnostics, identifying abnormal device function and complex arrhythmias

• Document findings accurately and professionally, communicating with providers as needed according to PaceMate's best practice standards

• Work independently to manage your daily workflow while collaborating closely with teammates and clinical leadership to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely interpretations

• Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and PHI protocols

• Contribute to our patient-centered care philosophy-at PaceMate®, every teammate is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient

What We’re Looking For

• Minimum two years of recent cardiac device management experience, OR successful completion of a formal cardiac rhythm management program

• Hands-on experience interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for at least three of the four major manufacturers: Medtronic, Abbott, Boston Scientific, and Biotronik

• Proficiency in ECG/EGM interpretation, including complex arrhythmia recognition

• Moderate to advanced technical skills

• Dedicated home workspace free from distractions, with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to work independently while engaging actively with your team throughout the day

• Ability to pass PaceMate's candidate technical assessment during the interview process

Nice-to-Haves

• Bachelor's or associate degree in a related field (nursing, cardiovascular technology, biomedical engineering, or similar) not required but strongly preferred

• IBHRE Certification (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) not required but strongly preferred; CCT or CRAT a plus

• Industry experience with cardiac rhythm management

• Proficiency with collaboration tools including Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and Slack

Physical Requirements

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is consistently required to remain in a stationary position, constantly operate a computer or other office equipment, and frequently communicate with customers and employees.

• Must be able to exchange accurate information, with the ability to effectively utilize voice over internet protocol; and repetitive motions using fingers and forearms in data entry.

• You must reside within the geography of the territory.

• You must only work from within the contiguous Unites States.

• If working from, residing at a location other than your legal address that PaceMate® has on file, employee must inform IT and get approval to do so.

• Whenever Confidential information is carried by a Pace Mate worker into a foreign country; the information is either stored in some inaccessible form, such as an encrypted external storage media, or always remain in the worker's possession.

• PaceMate's workers shall not take Secret Pace Mate information into another country unless the permission has been obtained from Physical Security management

title: DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
description:
About the job SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.
The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.
Responsibilities:

• Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.

• Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.

• Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.

• Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.

• Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.

• Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.

• Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.

• Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

• 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.

• Understanding of banking data environment.

• Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.

• Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.

• Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.

• In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.

• Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.

• Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

title: BlueCherry ERP Support Consultant
description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced, senior-level BlueCherry ERP professional to own functional support, business process guidance, and best-practice adoption for our BlueCherry ERP platform. The right person brings deep working knowledge of BlueCherry's functionality and its strategic application to a vertically integrated wholesale business.
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary point of contact for BlueCherry ERP functionality, including order management, purchasing, inventory, warehouse management, EDI, and PLM.

• Partner with sales operations, supply chain, finance, and customer service to translate B2B / wholesale business needs into BlueCherry configurations, workflows, and reporting.

• Own and continuously improve business processes and best practices within BlueCherry that reflect a wholesale model - order-to-cash, EDI trading-partner onboarding, allocation, chargebacks, and account-level terms.

• Triage day-to-day support issues, resolve functional and process-level questions directly, and determine what requires escalation.

• Manage the day-to-day relationship with CGS (BlueCherry's vendor): scope and escalate technical/engineering issues, track tickets, and coordinate upgrades, patches, and enhancement requests.

• Lead user training, documentation, and change management for BlueCherry across the organization.

• Evaluate new BlueCherry releases and features and recommend adoption based on business impact.

• Support integration points between BlueCherry and adjacent systems (EDI, WMS, finance, B2B ordering portals).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase system adoption, data quality, and process efficiency across the business.

Required Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering BlueCherry ERP (or a comparable apparel/fashion-vertical ERP) in a functional/business capacity.

• Direct experience in a B2B / wholesale apparel or footwear business - order management, EDI, allocation, chargebacks - rather than pure retail or DTC.

• Strong understanding of apparel supply chain processes: order-to-cash, purchasing, inventory, warehouse management, and PLM.

• Experience managing a technical vendor/implementation partner relationship (e.g., CGS) for engineering and technical support.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into system configuration and process design.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills; comfortable operating at a director / senior manager level.

• Excellent communication, training, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience at CGS, or as a BlueCherry implementation/functional consultant.

• Familiarity with EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) common in wholesale apparel.

• Exposure to adjacent fashion ERP/PLM tools (Centric, YuniquePLM, Infor Fashion, NGC) is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

• BlueCherry runs reliably with strong user adoption and satisfaction across business teams.

• Support issues are resolved quickly, with CGS engaged efficiently only where true technical/engineering work is needed.

• Business best practices for wholesale operations are documented, adopted, and consistently followed.

We Offer
Job Type:Full-Time - Contract, Remote (ET)
Competitive salary based on experience
Capnexus is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees. Experience comes in many forms, and we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with what we have listed. We look forward to hearing from you.

• At least 1.5+ years of sourcing/buying experience in vendor management, supplier coordination, negotiations, quoting, procurement, or a related field.

• At least 1.5+ years of fabric and trims sourcing experience , with familiarity with the Guangzhou Zhongda fabric market and/or Dongguan fabric markets.

• Strong understanding of fabric, trims, garment manufacturing, and supplier capabilities.

title: Senior Operations Manager for Travel Agency
description:
ABOUT TRAVEL HACK
Travel Hack is a membership-based online travel platform. Our members join a closed user group and unlock private rates on millions of hotels and vacation rentals: pricing the open market does not show. We are a Delaware corporation with a small senior team of operators, engineers, and commercial leads, and we are in launch phase right now. The systems you help build in your first months will run the company for years.
This is not a big-company ops seat with a playbook handed to you. You will help write the playbook.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Vendor research and comparison memos. Scope options, compare vendors, recommend one, and show your work.

• Vendor and partner coordination. Follow-ups, applications, and verification requirements across our booking-engine vendor, payment providers, phone system, and support partners. You keep every thread warm and every loop closing.

• Domain and DNS coordination. Records, verifications, and handovers between our registrar and the dev team.

• App store administration. Developer account setup, business registrations, and verification requirements for the two major app stores.

• Email marketing operations. Flow structure and segmentation inside our email platform (welcome, abandoned-cart, and price-drop journeys). Copy and design stay with the marketing lane; the plumbing is yours.

• Contract and hiring admin. Engagement paperwork, hiring support, and brand asset management.

• Quality assurance passes on member-facing builds and site testing support.

• A daily written end-of-day report. Fixed structure, bullets only, every claim backed by a link or screenshot. This is how leadership sees your work, so treat it as a first-class deliverable.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

• Days 1 to 30: Your daily report lands on time, every working day, and reads clean. You have mapped our vendor landscape and taken over active follow-up threads without dropping one.

• Days 31 to 60: You have shipped at least two vendor comparison memos that led to a decision. Domain, app store, and email-platform admin run through you. Nothing in your lane surprises your manager.

• Days 61 to 90: You spot gaps before they are pointed out, and your recommendations get approved with fewer edits. You are trusted with more, because you showed evidence for everything you claimed.

HOW WE WORK

• Spot gaps, then bring a move. We want people who notice the missing owner, the missing deadline, the missing escalation path, and flag it with a recommended fix attached. Raising a problem without a proposed next step is half a job.

• Proactive by default. If a task completes and the next step is obvious, start it. Ask first when the action is irreversible, expensive, or externally visible.

• Evidence over claims. Nothing is reported as delivered without confirmation from the outside world. This rule does not bend.

• Draft, then approve. Anything a vendor, partner, or member could see goes to your manager first. Your deliverable is a recommendation ready for review.

• Written by default, sync on Thursdays. Work lives in Asana with clear owners and due dates. You send a structured written report at the end of every working day, and once a week we hold an operations huddle, camera on.

• Absorb load, do not route it up. Escalate what genuinely needs leadership. Everything else, you handle and report.

• No weekends. We do not work Saturdays or Sundays and we do not ask you to. Deadlines that fall on a weekend move.

• Direct communication. Feedback here is sharp, specific, and aimed at the work. If you want a manager who tells you exactly where the bar is, you will like it here.

• Begin your cover letter application with the word "Tailwind" as the very first word of your cover note. This is how we know you read the post.

Role Overview
The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo ’s Security department and delivers it through hands-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI-powered features, including problems with no established playbook.
The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person.
Key Responsibilities
AppSec strategy, standards, and influence

• Lead Apollo ’s multi-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence.

• Shape Engineering, Product, Platform, and Data roadmaps so security work is planned in early, and represent AppSec in cross-department decisions.

• Mentor senior engineers and security champions, grow the champions program, and help raise the hiring bar, so the AppSec program does not depend on one person’s expertise.

Secure architecture and vulnerability depth

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high-scale, multi-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists.

• Design and drive adoption of secure-by-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing.

• Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk-based severity decisions.

• Stay hands-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams.

Tooling, automation, and AI (AI-native by default)

• Set the standard for AI-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality.

• Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data-exfiltration paths.

What Good Looks Like (drafted from your mission and success sections)

• Owns AppSec strategy across a multi-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps.

• Solves ambiguous, no-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow.

• Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Augur

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate - not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights - all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products - it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

The Role

As a Platform Engineer at Augur, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, and scalability of our critical systems. You will bridge the gap between software development and IT operations by applying a software engineering mindset to system administration.

● System Architecture and Design: Design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that runs our platforms. Develop scalable, secure and highly reliable systems to support our services.
● Automation and Tooling: Automate manual operational tasks, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Develop and maintain tools to improve efficiency and reduce the potential for human error.
● Software Development: Write and review code (Ansible, Terraform, Python) for infrastructure automation, monitoring tools, and system improvements. Contribute to the development lifecycle to ensure reliability is built into our products from the start.
● Performance and Reliability: Proactively monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and low latency. Fill in the gaps in monitoring systems when observed.
● Incident Management: Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents. Lead incident response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
● Capacity Planning: Analyse system usage, cost and performance data to make informed decisions about resource allocation. Forecast future infrastructure needs and scale our systems accordingly.
● Collaboration and Best Practices: Work closely with software development teams to promote reliability best practices. Champion a culture of reliability across the engineering organisation.
● Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all systems, processes, and operational procedures as a core part of everyday work. Treat documentation as a first-class engineering deliverable.

Accessibility and inclusivity

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.

title: GTM Engineer
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . title: Senior Robotics Engineer
description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.
The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year.
We are seeking a highly skilled and autonomous Senior Robotics Engineer to play a critical role in investigating and diagnosing complex autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors across on-road, resimulation, and synthetic simulation environments. This engineer will be responsible for taking end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problem spaces, utilizing Python, custom Spaceship tooling, and data visualization platforms to effectively perform root-cause analysis on emergent behaviors across our autonomy stack. Their work will directly contribute to accelerating the development of safe and reliable autonomous technologies by transforming deep technical debugging into clear summaries that support unified release narratives and executive insights.
What You'll Be Doing

•
System Diagnosis & Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep technical investigations of undesirable AV behaviors across simulation, HIL, and on-road operations. Take end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, driving solutions autonomously from initial triage to final resolution with little to no oversight.

•
Cross-Subsystem Debugging: Debug behaviors across perception, prediction, localization, planning, controls, and vehicle systems. Reason across subsystem boundaries to diagnose emergent behaviors resulting from component interactions.

•
Data Analysis & Tooling: Analyze large datasets from system logs, telemetry, and software outputs using Python. Develop automated diagnostic workflows and custom internal tooling using Python and Spaceship to increase the speed and scale of investigations.

•
Performance Visualization: Design and build interactive dashboards using Python frameworks and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker) to effectively measure, analyze, and report on the performance of our AV systems.

•
Hypothesis Generation: Develop technical hypotheses from incomplete or ambiguous evidence, distinguish behavioral symptoms from underlying root causes, and design analyses to systematically test potential causes.

•
Problem Space Identification: Autonomously identify recurring undesirable behaviors, regressions, and emerging system-level performance issues, categorizing them into meaningful failure modes.

•
Technical Storytelling & Synthesis: "Dive deep" into technical complexities to uncover root causes, then step back to synthesize findings. Translate raw performance metrics into clear summaries that support executive-level reporting, unified release narratives, and cross-functional communication.

What We're Looking For

•

title: Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
description:
ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We are an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, research and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

THE ROLE

Babbel Labs is rebuilding how learning content is created, stored and served, and how we decide what a learner sees next. The architecture for that is being set now, by a small number of engineers, and this role is one of them.

You will build and run the services behind it, in a serverless-first TypeScript and Node stack on AWS, owning them from the contract at their edge to their behaviour under load.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will design, build, ship and operate, and the seniority shows in the decisions you own rather than in a team reporting to you.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

- Build and evolve services across our learning platform, owning each one from its API contract through to what runs in production.

- Take on services you did not write, alongside the people who did.

- Design API and data contracts that hold up over time, with type-safe transforms between the API, the domain and persistence.

- Run what you build. Instrument it, know how it fails, change live data safely, and be the person who works out why it broke.

- Deliver with coding agents as a matter of course, and verify what they produce before you rely on it.

YOUR SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong, hands-on backend engineering in TypeScript and Node as your primary working language today. We mean back-end services: not build tooling, and not the server a front-end framework happens to ship with.

- Deep, practical AWS experience in a serverless-first setting. Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and event streaming are our daily tools, and we want someone who has designed against them rather than only deployed onto them.

- The ability to design API and data contracts and to model a domain, including type-safe transforms at the boundaries between the API, the domain and persistence.

- Real production ownership. You have instrumented your own services, understood their failure modes, changed live data without losing any, and worked incidents on systems you owned.

- Coding agents are part of your daily workflow, and you check their output before you rely on it. You are neither dismissive of them nor careless with them.

- Self-sufficiency. You get yourself unstuck in an unfamiliar codebase without a minder, and you work within its grain rather than rewriting what you have not yet understood.

- Working familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines, enough to ship and change your own service's delivery. This is not an infrastructure role, so depth here is not the bar.

- Python as a welcome secondary language. Some of our services are Python, and a Labs engineer can expect to touch them.

NICE TO HAVE

- Go or Rust for performance-critical components. Fully optional.

- Experience with a monorepo build system and shared tooling.

- Public technical work, such as open-source contributions or writing.

WAYS OF WORKING

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small team that moves fast, agent-first, but with a structured and disciplined delivery approach. It is remote and Berlin-friendly. The interview process is deliberately short: an initial screen, followed by one working session with the hiring manager.

Diversity at Babbel

As part of our ongoing journey towards building a diverse, equitable and inclusive company, we welcome everyone to apply, especially those individuals who are underrepresented in tech. We are a learning company, inside and out, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not fit all the technical requirements - all candidates are assessed based on skills, qualifications and on our business needs. title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

description:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.
L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :
Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.
Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.
Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :

• Préparer et mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode pour des systèmes de stockage électrochimique de l’énergie.

• Réaliser des mesures électrochimiques afin d’évaluer les propriétés et les performances des matériaux étudiés.

• Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation.

• Présenter les résultats obtenus et participer aux discussions scientifiques autour du projet.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?
Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

• Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

• Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

• Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

• Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

That’s why we’re searching for a Support Systems Engineer to become the long-term owner of our Support systems.

If you love wrangling operational complexity, building durable systems, and being the person a team relies on to keep everything running well, this is the role for you.

We’re looking for someone who wants to plant a flag in Support Operations, with the experience to independently lead a system implementation and the ambition to keep raising the bar as our Support team grows and the systems and workflows we rely on become more complex.

Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog's Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.

If you like adding value and seeing the direct impact of your work, and you thrive in dynamic environments where you can roll up your sleeves and get things done, this role is for you.

The Opportunity

Datadog's Enterprise business across EMEA continues to scale, and we're looking for a Field Enablement Manager to deliver ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement for Enterprise sellers across key EMEA markets (including the UK, DACH, France, Benelux, and the Nordics) - ensuring global enablement programs land effectively amid complex, multi-country Enterprise deals.

You'll serve as a trusted partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, adapting global programs to the realities of the EMEA Enterprise motion - longer sales cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees, and a diverse regional footprint - while staying tightly aligned with our global Field Enablement organization.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives operating independently, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement programs to meet the needs of a fast-growing, sophisticated Enterprise segment.

title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
As an Account Executive (AE) on our Commercial Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across small to midsize markets. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. AEs have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity

• Become a Datadog expert through continued product and sales trainings

• Manage the full sales cycle, including technical demonstrations and negotiation 

• Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity

• Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end-users

Who You Are:

• Curious, driven, and motivated as a sales person

• Creative in how you map and break into accounts

• Able to learn from feedback and champion a growth mindset

• Comfortable operating in a highly technical, fast paced environment

• Experienced in carrying quota, with a proven track record of success

• Prior experience closing technology sales deals in the Singapore and Philippine markets is preferred

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

• High income earning opportunities based on self performance

• New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 

• Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 

• An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds

• Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Partner Manager (x/f/m)
description:
WERDE TEIL UNSERER MISSION, WERDE TEIL VON DOCTOLIB!

Wir suchen Dich als Partner Manager (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Commercial Partnerships Team in Düsseldorf, Berlin, Hamburg, München oder Köln.

Deutschland hat eines der größten Netzwerke an Praxisberater:innen, Finanzdienstleistern und Marketingagenturen im Gesundheitswesen - und Doctolib möchte dieses Netzwerk gemeinsam mit ihnen weiter ausbauen. Unser Commercial Partnerships Team wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der aktiv neue regionale Partner gewinnt, inaktive Partnerschaften reaktiviert und das Doctolib-Partnernetzwerk in Deutschland auf das nächste Level hebt.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du gewinnst aktiv neue regionale Partner - von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss - und baust so das Doctolib-Partnernetzwerk in ganz Deutschland aus

- Du identifizierst inaktive Partner, entwickelst gezielte Reaktivierungsansätze und führst Partnerschaften zurück zur aktiven Zusammenarbeit

- Du onboardest neu gewonnene Partner und führst sie in das Doctolib-Produktuniversum ein, damit sie von Anfang an erfolgreich agieren können

- Du pflegst und entwickelst bestehende Partnerbeziehungen strategisch weiter und bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Deine Partner

- Du steuerst die Partner-Pipeline eigenständig und verantwortest die operative Umsetzung der Partnerschaftsstrategie

- Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit den Teams Partnerships und Marketing zusammen und trägst so zur Gesamtstrategie des Partnerkanals bei

DEIN PROFIL

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

- Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre nachgewiesene Vertriebserfahrung mit und weißt, wie Du Gespräche führst, Vertrauen aufbaust und Abschlüsse erzielst

- Du hast Erfahrung in der aktiven Gewinnung neuer Geschäftspartner - Hunting, Pitching und eigenständige Akquise sind Dir nicht fremd

- Du bist in der Lage, inaktive Partnerschaften zu identifizieren, gezielt anzusprechen und erfolgreich zu reaktivieren

- Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) für die Kommunikation mit Partnern im deutschen Markt; Englischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau (B1+) sind von Vorteil

- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B2

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

- Du hast Erfahrung im Partnermanagement, Channel Sales oder Kooperationsmanagement

- Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Netzwerk im Bereich Vertrieb oder Partnerschaften, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen

- Du hast Interesse an KI-Tools und möchtest diese zur Effizienzsteigerung in Deinem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

- Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

- Einen Firmenwagen - auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung

- 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

- Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

- Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

- Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u. v. m. enthält

- Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

- Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

- Interview mit Deiner Manager:in

- Case Study Interview

- Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

- Vollzeit
